scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.audio: Have you ever met the kind of person who talks about theory with great eloquence but ends up in a mess when actually doing it? Or have you ever fallen into the trap of being an armchair strategist yourself?

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.audio: Hi everyone, I am Li Taixin. I was once a top 100 global sales consultant for Porsche. My goal is to help all sales consultants live a more relaxed life.

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: Just like someone who can drive doesn't necessarily know the principles of the engine, and those who only memorize engine knowledge but can't get on the road to drive are also useless. Only by actually driving on the road can you accumulate real combat experience.

scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.audio: According to a corporate training statistic, only 10% of people can implement the knowledge they learned after training. The remaining 90% mostly forget it after hearing it. This also shows how difficult and precious the unity of knowledge and action is.

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.audio: The famous American basketball coach John Wooden led his team to success by constant practice and repeated implementation, letting the players turn theory into muscle memory.

scenes.label: Call to Action
scenes.audio: So theory is important, but only practice can upgrade your professionalism. Want to know how to quickly apply what you've learned to the sales scene? Come and find me. Let's turn knowledge into real power together. Bye-bye.
